highlights: Developed a high-end brand monitoring and sentiment analysis pipeline using Python and NLP techniques to classify public sentiment across 9,000+ labeled Twitter posts.
Engineered text representations with TF-IDF and GloVe embeddings to convert raw social media content into features suitable for deep learning models.
Trained and compared neural network architectures, including a TF-IDF–based deep neural network and an LSTM model, to evaluate performance under class imbalance.
Achieved an AUC score of 87% on a highly imbalanced dataset through model tuning and regularization, demonstrating reliable sentiment classification for brand analysis use cases.
